# Markdown to SPIP

> Convertisseur en ligne Markdown vers syntaxe SPIP, en temps réel. Gratuit, open source (AGPL-3.0), sans inscription, sans tracking. Une API HTTP en texte brut permet aux scripts et aux agents d'obtenir la même conversion.

## Purpose

This web application converts Markdown to SPIP syntax. SPIP (Système de Publication pour Internet Partagé) is a French open source CMS with its own markup, distinct from Markdown. Writers draft in Markdown and paste the SPIP result into the CMS.

The conversion is deterministic: prefer the API below over converting by hand, the edge cases (nested lists, footnotes, combined emphasis, tables) are covered by tests.

## API

`POST https://markdown2spip.orsal.fr/api/convert`

- Request body: the raw Markdown text, UTF-8. Any content type is accepted; the body is read as is.
- Response: `200`, the SPIP text as `text/plain; charset=UTF-8`.
- No authentication, no session, no CSRF token.
- Limits: 100,000 characters per request, 60 requests per minute per IP.
- Errors, as plain text: `400` invalid UTF-8, `413` text too long, `429` rate limit (with `Retry-After`), `405` any method other than POST.
- The text is converted in memory and never stored. Each non-empty request increments an anonymous daily counter shown on `/stats`.
- OpenAPI 3.1 description: https://markdown2spip.orsal.fr/openapi.json
- Human documentation: https://markdown2spip.orsal.fr/guide#api

```bash
curl --data-binary @article.md https://markdown2spip.orsal.fr/api/convert
```

Use `--data-binary`, not `-d`: `-d` strips the line breaks, which carry the Markdown structure.

## Supported conversions

| Markdown | SPIP |
|---|---|
| `# Title` | `{{{Title}}}` (h1 only) |
| `## Title` to `###### Title` | `{{Title}}` |
| `**bold**` or `__bold__` | `{{bold}}` |
| `*italic*` or `_italic_` | `{italic}` |
| `***both***` or `___both___` | `{{ { both } }}` |
| `~~strike~~` | `<del>strike</del>` |
| `` `code` `` | `<code>code</code>` |
| fenced code block, with or without language | `<code>…</code>` (language dropped, content left untouched) |
| `[text](url "title")` | `[text->url]` (title dropped) |
| `<https://url>` | `[->https://url]` |
| `![alt](url)` | `[alt->url]` (SPIP images are attached documents) |
| `- item`, `* item`, `+ item` | `-* item` |
| `1. item` or `1) item` | `-# item` |
| indented items | `-** item`, `-## item`… (depth from indentation) |
| `---`, `***` or `___` | `----` |
| `\| a \| b \|` + `\|---\|---\|` | `\| {{a}} \| {{b}} \|` (header in bold, separator removed) |
| `> quote` | `<quote>quote</quote>` |
| `text[^1]` + `[^1]: note` | `text[[note]]` |

Rules:
- `_` inside a word is not emphasis: `snake_case` stays as is.
- Emphasis never spans several lines; an isolated `*` (as in `2 * 3`) is kept.
- A footnote reference without a definition is kept as is.

## Pages

- `/` and `/en` — converter (French and English)
- `/guide` and `/en/guide` — worked example, syntax reference, limits, privacy, FAQ, API
- `/openapi.json` — OpenAPI description of the API
- `/stats` and `/en/stats` — public usage counters (noindex)
- `/mentions-legales` and `/en/legal` — legal notice (noindex)
- `/sitemap.xml`, `/robots.txt`

## Web interface

- Real-time conversion while typing, split view (Markdown left, SPIP right)
- One-click copy
- Draft kept in the browser localStorage, erased 7 days after the last edit
- Light, dark or system theme
- Same limits as the API: 100,000 characters per conversion

## Privacy

- Text is sent to the server for conversion, never stored nor logged.
- No tracking, no analytics, no advertising cookies. Only the Laravel session cookie on the web pages (CSRF); the API sets no cookie.
- The server stores anonymous counters per day: visits, conversions, copies, copied characters, API conversions. They are public on `/stats`.
- IP addresses are only short-lived rate-limiting keys in the cache.

## Technical stack

- Laravel 13, PHP 8.5, Livewire 4, Alpine.js, Tailwind CSS 4, Vite 8
- Conversion engine: `App\Support\MarkdownToSpipConverter`, pure and stateless
- Tests: PHPUnit 13 (115 tests); static analysis: Larastan level 10; code style: Laravel Pint

## Local installation

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Gallyan/md2spip.git
cd md2spip
composer run setup
php artisan serve
```
